text.p: Belgian brokerage KB Securities recommends investors to buy shares in Belgian car importer D'Ieteren because of its strong profit outlook.
Analyst Dirk Marckx (+32 2 546 4174) said the launch of six new models by the Volkswagen group, a key supplier, would have a positive impact on earnings this year and next.
Earnings prospects for car rental unit Avis Europe were also good. In Belgium D'Ieteren's market share was growing.
The outlook was for current profit to rise by 37.9 percent in 1997, 19.5 percent in 1998 and 11.9 percent in 1999.
D'Ieteren's order book was well filled, KB Securities said, forecasting total new car registrations on the Belgian market at 392,000 for 1997 and 405,000 for both 1998 and 1999.

Based on a current EPS of 405 Belgian francs for 1997 and 483 francs for 1998, the stock had a P/E of respectively 18.3 and 15.4. The current EPS calculated by KB-securities is after goodwill charges.
Estimates: (in Belgian francs, source KB Securities, July 4)
